description: Search and analyze products, reviews, posts, comments, creators, and trends across major global commerce and social platforms.

display.description_en: Search and analyze products, reviews, posts, comments, creators, and trends across major global commerce and social platforms.
display.description_zh: 查询与分析全球主流电商和社媒平台的商品、评论、内容、创作者与趋势数据。
examples_en: Find the product details and first 20 Amazon US reviews for MacBook Air M4, then summarize the main pros and cons
Search TikTok for popular home energy storage videos and organize the topics users care about most
Compare prices, ratings, and review feedback for similar wireless earbuds on Walmart and Target
Find a brand's recent YouTube videos and analyze consumer opinions in the comments
Collect 500 reviews for an Amazon product and keep reporting the collection progress
examples_zh: 查询 Amazon 美国站上 MacBook Air M4 的商品详情和前 20 条评论，总结主要优缺点
搜索 TikTok 上关于家用储能的热门视频，并整理用户最关注的话题
比较 Walmart 和 Target 上同类无线耳机的价格、评分和评论反馈
查找 YouTube 上某个品牌近期的视频，并分析评论中的消费者观点
采集某个 Amazon 商品的 500 条评论，并持续汇报采集任务进度
